Ct. App. Minn. Motion of Securities Industry Association et al. for leave to file a brief as amici ctiriae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Rodriguez de Quijas v. Shearson/American Express, Inc., ante, p. 477.

Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this case.
